headlines.description: — Marat Khusnutdinov and Casey Mittelstadt scored less than a minute apart early in the first period and the Boston Bruins held on for a 2-1 victory over the Pittsburgh Penguins on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: The Bruins beat the Penguins 2-1 as Khusnutdinov, Mittelstadt score 50 seconds apart

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Buffalo Sabres

headlines.description: — Tage Thompson scored after being honored for helping the U.S. win an Olympic gold medal in hockey, and the Buffalo Sabres won their fourth...
headlines.shortLinkText: Thompson honored for Olympic gold-medal win, then scores in Sabres' 3-2 victory over Golden Knights

events.name: Florida Panthers at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — U.S. Olympic golden goal-scorer Jack Hughes extended his points streak to four games since returning from Milan, and the New Jersey Devils dealt the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jack Hughes and the Devils deal the Panthers' playoff hopes another blow by beating them 5-1

headlines.description: — JJ Peterka scored in the second period on a bizarre bounce, and the Utah Mammoth beat the Washington Capitals 3-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mammoth hold off Capitals 3-2, dropping Washington 4 points back of a playoff spot

events.name: Nashville Predators at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Damon Severson broke a tie with a snap shot from the point through traffic at 6:07 of the third period and the Columbus Blue Jackets beat the Nashville Predators 3-2 on Tuesday night to open a four-game homestand.
headlines.shortLinkText: Severson breaks 3rd-period tie in the Blue Jackets' 3-2 win over the Predators

headlines.description: — Mark Scheifele scored at 2:06 of overtime to lift the Winnipeg Jets to a 3-2 victory over the Chicago Blackhawks on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Scheifele scores in overtime as the Jets beat the Blackhawks 3-2

headlines.description: — Sam Steel scored twice and added an assist and the Dallas Stars extended their franchise-record winning streak to 10 games with a 6-1 romp over the Calgary Flames on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stars extend franchise-record winning streak to 10 with 6-1 romp over Flames

headlines.description: — Leon Draisaitl had two goals and three assists, Evan Bouchard scored on a power play at 1:50 of overtime and the Edmonton Oilers rallied to beat the Ottawa Senators 5-4 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Draisaitl, Bouchard lead Oilers to 5-4 OT win over Senators

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Minnesota Wild

headlines.description: — Kirill Kaprizov broke the franchise career goals record with 220, Mats Zuccarello, Brock Faber and Quinn Hughes each had a goal and assist and the Minnesota Wild beat the Tampa Bay Lightning 5-1 Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kaprizov breaks franchise career goals record in Wild's 5-1 win over Lightning

headlines.description: — Cale Makar had a goal and two assists, Nathan MacKinnon secured his fourth consecutive 100-point season with a third-period assist, and the NHL-leading Colorado Avalanche snapped the Anaheim...
headlines.shortLinkText: Cale Makar, Parker Kelly lead Avalanche past Ducks 5-1 for a SoCal sweep

events.name: Montreal Canadiens at San Jose Sharks

headlines.shortLinkText: Celebrini has 4 points, Sherwood scores go-ahead goal as Sharks beat Canadiens 7-5
